instruction: Candid medium shot of an indoor birthday party setting. The girl with curly dark hair (R2), wearing a red turtleneck and dark blue skirt, stands on the left, facing right with her arms outstretched to embrace her friend. The girl with long wavy brown hair (R8), wearing a yellow-striped shirt and black overalls, stands on the right, facing left. She laughs joyfully while holding a wrapped gift box, leaning in to return the hug. In the background, a grey sofa is decorated with colorful balloons and a birthday banner, alongside a large green potted plant. The scene is brightly lit with soft, warm light, creating a cheerful atmosphere.
